headline: Clear current degradation after observed route recovery

items.title: Clear current degradation after observed route recovery
items.insight: The route ledger records recovery, but the public feed keeps a coarse outage clock running. Scope current bounds to the active route episode and retain historical corroboration separately.
items.evidence: Recovered and unobserved feeds have null current onset bounds and zero duration even with coarse/RUM evidence. Open incident evidence and historical incident durations remain intact; recurrence is not backdated across a verified recovery. Public status projects corrected fields; full suite, staging and exact production acceptance pass.
